tube_od.interpretation: SNL261/262 explicitly gives quarter-inch OUTSIDE diameter for the bearing feed tubes.

tube_radial_gap.interpretation: Tube-to-sleeve display clearance; compressed seal and tube wall are not qualified.

spigot_length.interpretation: Assumed cap inlet engagement, equal to current estimated front cup-wall thickness.

elbow_radius.interpretation: Estimated elbow body and spigot outside radius.

elbow_straight.interpretation: Estimated straight wrench section beyond cup face.

spigot_radial_gap.interpretation: Smooth-envelope receiving-bore clearance; omitted thread form.

connector_radius.interpretation: Estimated outside thread envelope; no thread pitch asserted.

connector_top.interpretation: Estimated upper end of elbow connection relative to inlet axis.

nut_top.interpretation: Estimated nut top relative to inlet axis.

nut_thread_gap.interpretation: Radial clearance of cylindrical thread envelopes, not a thread-fit result.

seat_top_radius.interpretation: Estimated conical sleeve seat upper radius.

sleeve_bottom.interpretation: Estimated compressed sleeve lower end on cone.

inlet_y.interpretation: Offset on front cup wall; exact face/side not established by HB20 perspective.

inlet_z.interpretation: Low cup inlet suggested by HB20; exact height unmeasured.

gallery_z.interpretation: Low feed gallery from cup to running surface; route unshown in sources.

packing_wall_gap.interpretation: Display separation from cup walls; wool is permeable, not a sealed solid block.

packing_quantity_oz.interpretation: SNL56/274: two ounces per cap, eight total; not a count of discrete wool parts.

interpretations: Elbow datum lies on the estimated front cup face. Local+X points forward/outward and local+Z up; all four caps use the same unhanded fitting.

SH664C is represented as the cap fitting sleeve captured between the SH664A cone and SH664B shoulder. Exact historical fitting cross-section is unknown; A16323 remains a separate unallocated collet identity.
Wool is one permeable material envelope per cup, annotated with source mass quantity. Individual fibers, density, pore structure and hydrodynamic behavior are not modeled.
One low horizontal passage crosses cap and front lining to the sleeve running interface. Geometry is an explicit reconstruction assumption, not a transcribed drilling specification.
